newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-JAILED FORMER BORDEAUX BOSS WINS PARTIAL FREEDOM.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JAILED FORMER BORDEAUX BOSS WINS PARTIAL FREEDOM.

text.p: Former Bordeaux president Claude Bez, imprisoned in August for fraud, has won partial freedom.

Bez, sentenced to three years in prison with one year suspended, has won an appeal on grounds of poor health and from Monday can leave his cell every morning to go to work but must return in the evening.

Bez, stripped of his accountant's licence and now merely an employee in his own company, embezzled public funds when work at Bordeaux's training facility was estimated at some 50 million francs ($10 million) but cost less than half the ammount.
